doc.title: A.B. Spellman interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 19, 2022

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: I see. Well I have enjoyed this conversation so much, and I’ll do something that interviewers really aren’t supposed to do but I’ll do it anyway. Is there anything that you’d like to talk about that I haven’t asked you?
Let me think. No, I’m pretty much talked out. I’m getting a little hoarse in the throat now.
Can’t talk as long as I used to.

Yeah. Well I’m going to paraphrase something you wrote in your introduction to your Four Lives in Bebop and I’m paraphrasing for this occasion, and I’ll say, “I hope I have not put any words in your mouth, you have enough marvelous words of your own.”
Thank you a lot, Monk, I enjoyed this talking to you.
I appreciate it Mr. Spellman, and I’ll sign off our recording and then we’ll just say goodbye.
You’ll send me a copy of this, right?
